content.title: Bluetooth 5.2 Core Specification and LE Audio Introduction
content.body: Summary: This document specifies the core specification that introduced LE Audio. Document reference: OFFICIAL-PRIMARY-2025-05-21. Effective: 2025-05-21. The Standards Authority confirms that Bluetooth 5.2 is the core specification that introduced LE Audio. This version encompasses the foundational features enabling the new audio architecture, including enhanced isochronous channels and the LC3 codec. These elements support the low-power, high-quality audio transmission characteristic of LE Audio. This specification supersedes prior versions with respect to audio capabilities. All subsequent LE Audio implementations shall reference this core specification. The authority maintains that this determination is final and authoritative. No further amendments are anticipated. This document serves as the primary reference for developers and manufacturers.

content.headline: Bluetooth 5.2 Standard Brings LE Audio to Market
content.body: Continental Wire Service — The Bluetooth SIG has confirmed that Bluetooth 5.2 is the core specification that introduced LE Audio, a major step forward for wireless audio. LE Audio, which includes features like broadcast audio and improved hearing aid support, is now available to device makers. This new standard enables more efficient audio streaming with lower power consumption. Industry analysts note that the shift to Bluetooth 5.2 will drive innovation in earbuds, hearing aids, and other audio devices. Consumers can expect a wave of new products in the coming months. The specification's rollout marks a significant milestone in wireless technology.
